reviewer.note: Review at 9366301b (main bytes), docs/reviews/2026-11-08-crossroads-placed.md. Bed frames: the top rails carry a stamped diagonal tick every ~4.5 texels that reads as twisted rope, not grain; the lower rails carry flat grey 2x2 dot nails on the dark seam with no lit pixel or rust (calibration C1 "dot nails"); no butt joints on 130-texel boards. Fix: grain as irregular 2-4 px streaks along each board, butt joints every 14-30 px with a nail head (dark, lit pixel above, sitting in the board) beside each, one of three sibling ramps per board. Seedlings are one 5x3 stamp in an exact 4x10 grid: three variants, +/-1 texel jitter. The dirt pad round the beds is closed by a straight dark outline (ground meeting ground is never outlined, eastward-edges 4.1, 5.1): drop the outline and fray the pad edge 2-3 px. Soil furrows, clods and the occlusion under the north rails pass.
